entries.title: Romans 12:1
segments: I entreat you therefore, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies to Him as a living sacrifice, holy and acceptable to God. This is your reasonable service of worship.

entries.title: Romans 12:2
segments: And be not conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your minds, so that you may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.

entries.title: Romans 12:3
segments: For, through the grace that was given to me, I tell every man among you not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but so to think, as to think soberly, according to the measure of faith which God has given him.

entries.title: Romans 12:4
segments: For even as we have many members in one body, and not all members have the same function;

entries.title: Romans 12:5
segments: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and we are severally members of one another.

entries.title: Romans 12:6
segments: But we have gifts differing according to the grace which was given to us. He that has the gift of prophecy, let him prophesy according to the proportion of his faith.

entries.title: Romans 12:7
segments: If it is the gift of administration, let us give ourselves to our service.

entries.title: Romans 12:8
segments: Let the teacher give himself to his teaching; and he who exhorts others to his exhortation. He who gives, let him do it in singleness of mind. He who rules, let him rule with diligence; and he who shows mercy must be cheerful.

entries.title: Romans 12:9
segments: Let love be without insincerity. Abhor what is evil; wed yourselves to what is good.

entries.title: Romans 12:10
segments: As for brotherly love, be tenderly affectionate one to another, in honor preferring one another.

entries.title: Romans 12:11
segments: In your diligence be free from sloth. Be glowing in spirit. Slave for the master.

entries.title: Romans 12:12
segments: Rejoice in hope; be patient under affliction; continue stedfast in prayer.

entries.title: Romans 12:13
segments: Be liberal to needy saints. Practise hospitality.

entries.title: Romans 12:14
segments: Bless your persecutors, bless, and curse not.

entries.title: Romans 12:15
segments: Rejoice with those who rejoice, and weep with those who weep.

entries.title: Romans 12:16
segments: Have full sympathy with one another. Set not your minds on high affairs, but associate with lowly folk. Do not be wise in your own conceits.

entries.title: Romans 12:17
segments: Do not pay back evil for evil. Aim to do what is honorable in the eyes of all.

entries.title: Romans 12:18
segments: If it be possible, so far as it lies with you, be at peace with all men.

entries.title: Romans 12:19
segments: Never revenge yourself, beloved, but leave the field clear for God's wrath; for it is written, "Vengeance is mine, I will repay," says the Lord.

entries.title: Romans 12:20
segments: On the contrary, therefore, If your enemy is hungry, feed him; if he is thirsty, give him drink; for by so doing you will be heaping burning coals on his head.

entries.title: Romans 12:21
segments: Do not be overcome by evil, but be overcoming evil with good.
